Seamless tileable square texture, strictly orthographic top-down view, flat even lighting with no directional shadows, no perspective, no horizon, no objects bigger than a hand, no borders, no frame, no text. Subject: a meadow grass ground seen from above, dense short grass painted as soft clumpy brush strokes in sage green, fresh green and a few honey-gold autumn tints, tiny scattered white and yellow flower dots, uniform density over the whole tile.
